scientific_role: Measure whether the three frozen causal primitives detect the same fixed-Control lifecycles, nearby lifecycle moments, or materially distinct lifecycle failure modes. This is not a combination test.

fixed_definitions.signal_lifecycle_set: For candidate X, the set of fixed Control lifecycle identities for which candidate_signal_time is non-null.
fixed_definitions.executed_lifecycle_set: For candidate X, the set of fixed Control lifecycle identities for which candidate_executed is true.
fixed_definitions.preempted_lifecycle_set: For candidate X, the set of fixed Control lifecycle identities for which native_preempted is true.
fixed_definitions.same_lifecycle_signal_overlap: A fixed Control lifecycle on which both members of a candidate pair emitted a signal.
fixed_definitions.same_lifecycle_execution_overlap: A fixed Control lifecycle on which both members of a candidate pair executed their candidate exit.
fixed_definitions.signal_time_delta_hours: candidate_2_signal_time - candidate_1_signal_time on same-lifecycle signal overlaps; signed hours.
fixed_definitions.simultaneous_signal: Both signals have identical candidate_signal_time. Since signals are generated on completed 4H closes, this is exact same-decision-bar simultaneity.
fixed_definitions.direct_effect_sign: POSITIVE if >0, NEGATIVE if <0, ZERO only within absolute tolerance 1e-9.
fixed_definitions.same_lifecycle_direct_sign_concordance: Whether two executed candidate exits on the same fixed Control lifecycle have the same direct-effect sign.

zero_denominator_policy: Return null metric plus explicit denominator=0; never coerce to zero similarity.

no_threshold_adjudication.reason: No Jaccard, containment, lag, or sign-concordance threshold is frozen for declaring candidates redundant or complementary. Raw metrics are the scientific output. Any later categorical interpretation requires a new protocol frozen before using it for architecture decisions.

post_execution_gate.architecture_progression_after_review_on: Only after a separate review may the project decide whether evidence justifies moving toward LIFECYCLE_STATE_MACHINE protocol work, repeating/closing a primitive, or another preregistered diagnostic.
